description: Look up exact-match and broad-match search volume for one or more Amazon keywords. Returns 30-day volume, year-over-year trend, quarterly trend, PPC bid estimates, and ease-of-ranking score. Uses the Jungle Scout keywords_by_keyword_query endpoint.

keywords.description: Keywords to look up exact and broad monthly search volume for. Each keyword is queried individually (up to 10 per call are processed). Example: ["yoga mat", "resistance bands"]

name: keyword_search_volume
title: Keyword search volume
